faq.question: What desk width works in a small apartment?
faq.answer: Most studios do best between 40 and 48 inches. Go narrower only if you primarily use a laptop and can mount the display on an arm.

faq.question: Do I need a standing desk?
faq.answer: Not always. If seating and screen height are already good, a shallow fixed desk can be the smarter space choice.

faq.question: Will these desks hold two monitors?
faq.answer: Many can, especially with a monitor arm. Check weight ratings and avoid balancing heavy screens on the far edge of a shallow top.
